role_source: OpenDota dotaconstants bf193a550f778dec35debf4d71d05a86bebcc418; descriptive role labels, not matchup ratings
hero_summary_zh: 无论是赶赴战场援助友军，还是累积资源准备下次突袭，自然先知仿佛无处不在。他可以随意传送到任何地方，立刻创造一群狂暴的树木为他作战，他出手的角度总是出乎敌人意料。
hero_summary_en: Whether in the thick of battle or gathering resources for his next assault, Nature's Prophet seems to be everywhere. Teleporting at will to any location and instantly creating an army of violent trees to fight for him, he attacks where enemies least expect.

abilities.name: furion_sprout
abilities.description_zh: 使一圈树木在一个单位的周围发芽，将其困在其中并造成伤害，提供%vision_range%范围内的视野。
abilities.description_en: Sprouts a ring of trees around a unit, damaging and trapping it in place and providing vision in a %vision_range% radius.
notes_zh: 发芽的施放目标可以是任何单位或者地面。
发芽产生的树木跟英雄技能的相互作用与平常树木相同。
notes_en: Sprout can be cast on any unit, or the ground.
Trees created by Sprout have the same interactions with abilities as regular trees.
facet_text_en: After Sprout is cast, all trees in a %healing_radius% radius emit an aura that heals nearby allies. Allied Tangos provide double the heal duration when consuming a tree created by Sprout.
facet_text_zh: 施放发芽后附近%healing_radius%范围内的树木会散发出治疗附近友军的光环。友军的树之祭祀吞食发芽产生的树木会提供双倍治疗时间。

abilities.name: furion_teleportation
abilities.description_zh: 传送到地图上任何位置。到达地点后获得一个护盾。
abilities.description_en: Teleports to any point on the map. Gains a barrier after arriving to its destination.
notes_zh: 魔耗和冷却时间都是在技能施放结束后结算。自然先知在施放技能时被打断将不会耗费魔法或使技能进入冷却。
施法开始后，目标地点将产生视觉特效，对队友和敌人均可见。
notes_en: Mana and cooldown take effect when the cast is completed.  Nature's Prophet will not use any mana or waste the cooldown if the spell is interrupted while casting.
When the cast begins, an effect is created at the target location, which is visible to allies and enemies.

abilities.name: furion_force_of_nature
abilities.description_zh: 将一片树木转化成由自然先知操控的树人。
abilities.description_en: Converts an area of trees into Treants under the command of Nature's Prophet.
notes_zh: 自然的呼唤产生的树人不会超过目标区域内树木的数量。
notes_en: Nature's Call can only create as many treants as there are trees in the target area.
facet_text_en: Summons a reduced number of stronger Treants with reinforced damage.
facet_text_zh: 召唤的树人数量减少，但是威力变大，而且拥有坚锐技能。

abilities.name: furion_curse_of_the_forest
abilities.description_zh: 对%range%范围内所有敌方英雄施加诅咒，使他们在迷雾中显形，根据%radius%范围内树木的数量对他们造成减速和持续伤害。在此情况下树人也被视为树木。
abilities.description_en: Applies a curse on all enemy heroes within %range% range, displaying them in fog, slowing them, and dealing damage over time based on the number of trees within %radius% radius. Treants count as trees for this purpose.

abilities.name: furion_spirit_of_the_forest
abilities.description_zh: 附近的每棵树都会让自然先知获得%damage_per_tree_pct%%%攻击力加成。每个树人也会让自然先知获得若干倍数的加成，不论相距多远。树人也拥有这个技能。
abilities.description_en: Nature's Prophet gains %damage_per_tree_pct%%% bonus damage for each nearby tree. Treants also provide this bonus with multiplied values regardless of proximity. Treants also possess this ability.
notes_zh: 树人会从周围的树木和其他树人获得加成效果。
树精卫士不提供任何加成。
notes_en: Treants gain bonuses from trees and other treants around them.
Treant Protector does not provide any bonuses.

abilities.name: furion_wrath_of_nature
abilities.description_zh: 伤害性的能量在全地图跳跃，打击视野中的敌人，会先从距目标点最近的敌人开始打击。每击中一个敌人伤害都会增加，击中%max_targets%个目标后达到最高伤害。
abilities.description_en: Damaging energy bounces around the map, striking enemies that are in vision starting with those closest to the cast point. Each enemy hit beyond the first adds damage, up to the maximum after %max_targets% are hit.
notes_zh: 自然的愤怒只能伤害视野内的单位。
可以通过点击小地图施放；初始目标将选择施放地点最近的有效单位。
notes_en: Wrath of Nature will not hit units out of vision.
Can be cast through the minimap; the nearest valid target will be selected.

scepter_loc.en: Entangles all enemies it hits. Duration scales from %scepter_min_entangle_duration%s up to %scepter_max_entangle_duration%s seconds at max bounce.
scepter_loc.zh: 缠绕所有击中的敌人。持续时间根据弹跳次序从%scepter_min_entangle_duration%秒开始增加，弹跳数达到上限时为%scepter_max_entangle_duration%秒。
